info.name: Dispatch Load Balancer
info.description:
Evaluation suite for the Dispatch Load Balancer. It targets the live deployment by default ({{baseUrl}} = https://dispatch-load-balancer-yl5j.onrender.com); set the collection variable baseUrl to http://localhost:8080 to test a local run.

Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. Every request has tests, and a collection-level script independently verifies every dispatch plan the server returns: capacity per vehicle, load sums, Haversine distances (recomputed in the test, +/-0.01 km), every order accounted for exactly once, addresses present, and the priority rule.

Folder 6 measures performance with up to 20,000 orders x 400 vehicles; the last folder restores the sample dataset.
